'''Abe Goldfarb''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with Bohemian Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Goldfarb is an American actor, writer, and voice actor who trained at the {{wp|Bristol Old Vic Theatre School}} and has worked with such companies as the {{wp|Hudson Valley Shakespeare Festival}}, Studio 42, and the {{wp|Jean Cocteau Repertory}}. Goldfarb joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} in the middle of {{aniseries|XY}}. His most prominent roles are [[Xerosic]] and {{an|Professor Kukui}}.
